summary: Red team of the accepted extraction of Burungale–Kobayashi–Ota, 'Rubin's conjecture on local units in the anticyclotomic tower at inert primes' (Annals 194 (2021) 943–966): 115 items (6 library, 10 planned, 99 missing) and 5 routes, including four Part IIs. 27 findings: 2 high, 12 medium and 13 low. The high findings: honda-lift still states Lemma 5.1(ii)'s printed signs, which the confirmed erratum E9 reverses, so route 2 would be asked to prove a false theorem; and Rubin's integral two-variable main conjecture at inert p, needed for Theorem 6.1 through Agboola–Howard's Proposition 3.3(ii), has no owner. BKO's notes assign it to CMAllPrimeMainConjectures, whose accepted brief says the integral equality 'is not an output here'. Among the medium findings: route 2's design id is shared with AGHMP18, and only one brief reaches the design job. A built Tau Ceti map Ê(𝔪_v) → E(K_v) with image the kernel of reduction is not cited, so routes 2–3 would rebuild it. Local Tate duality is claimed as planned for a formal-Kummer annihilator step that no stage plans. Hecke L-functions and root numbers are neither items nor imports, though AL.1 plans them. L_p lies in Λ_R, not Λ. The Agboola–Howard steps (4.2) and Theorem 4.3 behind Theorem 6.1 are not itemised. Rubin's L_p is planned twice (primitive-elliptic-unit is ξ_ν at ν = 1). Routes 3 and 4 depend on each other. Quasi-canonical lifts are also planned by two unitary-cycle extractions. The supersingular mass formula has the wrong owner. Agboola–Howard I is missing from the prerequisites. Three new minor mistakes in the paper are recorded, and the other statuses, stages and library claims were confirmed.

findings.claim: The planned item includes 'identify the formal Kummer cokernel with the dual norm limit'. Neither cited stage plans that. ClassFieldTheory Layer 5 plans the perfect pairing for finite modules, and ArithmeticGaloisDuality R02.1 plans coefficient limits. BKO's step (following Rubin 1987 §5) needs a formal-group local duality theorem: under the local Tate pairing, the Kummer image of F(L)/π^m is the exact annihilator of the Kummer image of the dual group. Only with that do Hazewinkel's vanishing of the norm limit and Tate duality give the vanishing of lim→ H¹(Θ_n, F(Φ̄))[π^{n+1}]. No item and no stage owns it, so the item overstates what is planned and hides a missing theorem.

findings.claim: Between AH and BKO, the 'opposite sign convention' relabels only the character sets: Ξ^±(BKO) = Ξ^∓(AH). AH's local condition E_± kills Ξ^∓(AH), while BKO's F^± kills Ξ^±(BKO). So H¹_±, Sel_±, S_± and X_± carry the same labels in both papers, and AH (3.3), Theorem 3.6 and (4.2) transfer unchanged. Only statements indexed by character sets flip. The notes' instruction to translate 'all signs … before use' invites a flip that would turn AH Theorem 3.6 into the false 'X^ε is torsion'.

findings.claim: (a) Route 1 asks CM.4 only to 'add its conductor and conjugation proof'.
